invariants: All statistical computation comes from engine.py or survival.py — never from LLM
Dataset identity verified before every execution — hash mismatch → BLOCKED
Locked analyses cannot be modified — modification creates new version
No p-value-based method selection
No causal language from observational data
No automatic outlier removal
No automatic imputation
Canonical test data never modified by tests
Patient identifiers never assigned outcome/exposure/survival_time/event_indicator roles
Every analytical decision captured in audit ledger
Publication outputs never recompute statistics or modify analysis results
AI never generates numerical results in outputs
Every output is traceable to dataset identity + analysis version + result fingerprint
Default outputs exclude raw patient-level data
Outputs distinguish primary/secondary/sensitivity/exploratory analyses
API routes cannot bypass output validation — rendering always revalidates
Approved and archived outputs are immutable
Rendering always revalidates dataset and analysis identity
Artifact retrieval cannot access arbitrary filesystem paths
API-generated outputs preserve provenance and audit history
Equivalent output requests are idempotent or explicitly versioned
Frontend never computes or modifies statistical results — all values from backend
Backend state is authoritative over frontend state for lifecycle, approval, datasets, outputs, provenance
Frontend cannot independently approve analyses or outputs — approval invokes backend lifecycle
Displayed workflow status corresponds to actual backend state — never fabricated
Frontend navigation preserves dataset → analysis → result → output provenance
Frontend actions that mutate state generate backend audit events
Frontend cannot silently modify source datasets or analytical specifications
Analysis plans persist to database via plan_persistence.py and survive restart
Dataset records and identity hashes persist across restart
Analysis run results and fingerprints persist across restart
Figures, tables, reports, and reproducibility packages persist across restart
All statistical methods match scipy/statsmodels/lifelines within documented tolerances
Researcher approve/reject decisions and decision traces persist across restart
Dataset identity → analysis → result → output chain is traceable and persists
Audit log entries survive application restart
Candidate method recommendations driven by study design and variable types, never by p-values
STATIS does not manipulate data, methods, exclusions, or classifications to improve significance
Zero survival events → NOT_DEFENSIBLE; PH violation → REVIEW_REQUIRED; sparse events <10 → REVIEW_REQUIRED
Stored results are consumed, not recomputed; engine is deterministic
LLM failures cause safe failure without data corruption
Complete workflow survives application restart via close_db + init_db cycle
